messages:
statusbot: :rotating_light: Paging: high error rate seen across generation endpoints in us-west-2. Alert triggered at 2026-03-15T09:14:14Z

alex (oncall): seeing 502s climbing ~3% -> 12% 5xx on gen-prod. CPU on a few inference hosts spiked, but not OOM. Starting triage. tagging: #incidents #sre

emily (sre): on it. alex can you paste the alert link + recent deploys?
alex (oncall): alert: https://ops/alerts/9876 - no deploys in last 40m, autoscaler did a small rebalance at 09:07. logs show a repeated timeout in kv-cache fetch from redis-cluster-3
maria (ops): re: kv-cache, redis metrics show higher p99 latency and a few connection resets around 09:12. I scaled replica set + recreated the hung connection on redis-cluster-3. monitoring still shows error rate not improved yet.
jon (pm): how much user impact? any customer-facing functions down? need to draft status page/update copy asap if this looks like >10% of requests failing for some customers.
emily (sre): early estimate: ~8-15% errors depending on region, primarily us-west-2. Some sessions get partial responses and retrying helps. Not seeing data egress issues.
alex (oncall): i'm preparing a short status page draft. posting below for quick review, please reply with edits. want to publish initial notice in ~10m if we confirm scope.

alex (oncall): DRAFT (initial update) -- please review:```
We are investigating an increased error rate for generation requests in us-west-2 observed since approximately 09:10 UTC. Users may see intermittent 5xx or truncated responses. Our engineers are actively investigating and have taken mitigations on the caching tier. We will provide updates as we learn more.
Affected services: Generation API (us-west-2)
Impact: Intermittent errors and degraded responses for a subset of requests
Workaround: Retry the request; transient retries may succeed
ETA for next update: 30 minutes
```

emily (sre): wording looks good. Suggest adding "no evidence of data loss" and call out that authentication and billing unaffected.
alex (oncall): updated: added no data loss + auth unaffected

alex (oncall): UPDATED DRAFT:```
We are investigating an increased error rate for generation requests in us-west-2 observed since approximately 09:10 UTC. Users may see intermittent 5xx or truncated responses. Our engineers are actively investigating and have taken mitigations on the caching tier. There is no evidence of data loss. Authentication and billing systems are unaffected.
Affected services: Generation API (us-west-2)
Impact: Intermittent errors and degraded responses for a subset of requests
Workaround: Retry the request; transient retries may succeed
ETA for next update: 30 minutes
```
maria (ops): small nit: change "Retry the request" -> "Transient retries may succeed; clients with exponential backoff will see better results". also recommend adding contact link for Dedicated customers.

jon (pm): add line for "Customers on Dedicated plans: if you see impact, open a support ticket or contact your SE"

alex (oncall): added both suggestions. final check: is legal ok with phrase "no evidence of data loss"? tagging legal-review.

legal-review: quick read — "no evidence of" is fine short-term but include a check-in to verify before final resolved notice. recommend we avoid definitive statements until postmortem.

emily (sre): ack. we'll keep it guarded. Change to "no current evidence of data loss".
alex (oncall): final draft below; publishing initial update now if no objections.```
Final draft (initial):```
We are investigating an increased error rate for generation requests in us-west-2 observed since approximately 09:10 UTC. Users may see intermittent 5xx or truncated responses. Our engineers are actively investigating and have taken mitigations on the caching tier. There is no current evidence of data loss. Authentication and billing systems are unaffected.
Affected services: Generation API (us-west-2)
Impact: Intermittent errors and degraded responses for a subset of requests
Workaround: Transient retries may succeed; clients with exponential backoff will see better results. Customers on Dedicated plans: if you see impact, please open a support ticket or contact your SE.
ETA for next update: 30 minutes
```

statusbot: :white_check_mark: Initial status update published to Statuspage at 2026-03-15T09:20:00Z by alex (oncall) — Incident ID INC-2026-0315-01

emily (sre): mitigation applied: restarted a subset of redis pods and removed a noisy node from the pool. error rate dropped from 12% -> 6% in 6 minutes. continuing monitoring and rolling additional fixes.

alex (oncall): publishing interim update now — posting below for quick signoff.

alex (oncall): INTERIM UPDATE (for statuspage)```
Mitigation actions (in progress): restarted affected cache pods and removed a noisy host from the pool. Error rates have decreased but remain above normal thresholds. Engineers are performing additional validation and staged restarts of cache replicas.
Customer impact: Intermittent 5xx responses and truncated outputs for a subset of generation requests in us-west-2. Impact reduced compared to initial report.
ETA for next update: 60 minutes
```

maria (ops): approve. would add "Investigating root cause (possible cache node instability)" so we set expectations.
emily (sre): done — added that sentence.

statusbot: :information_source: Interim status update published to Statuspage at 2026-03-15T09:36:21Z by emily (sre)

alex (oncall): resolving: after further restarts and replacement of the problematic host, error rates back to baseline (<1%). planning resolved notice. drafting resolved copy below — please confirm before publish.```

alex (oncall): RESOLVED DRAFT:```
We have resolved the increased error rate affecting generation requests in us-west-2. The issue began at approximately 09:10 UTC and was mitigated by restarting affected cache replicas and removing an unhealthy host from the cache pool. Error rates have returned to baseline and normal service has resumed. There is no current evidence of data loss. We are continuing to investigate the root cause and will publish a post-incident report with timelines and mitigations.
Affected services: Generation API (us-west-2)
Impact: Intermittent 5xx responses and truncated outputs for a subset of generation requests
Resolution time: 09:45 UTC
Follow-up: Post-incident report to be published within 72 hours
```

emily (sre): change "Resolution time: 09:45 UTC" -> 09:47 UTC to reflect last observed error.
alex (oncall): updated.

legal-review: fine to publish resolved — "no current evidence" language retained.

statusbot: :white_check_mark: Resolved notice published to Statuspage at 2026-03-15T09:47:21Z by alex (oncall). Incident closed.

jon (pm): thanks team. please file the post-incident doc with timeline, RCA, and action items. assign to emily + ops.
emily (sre): will open the postmortem and ping owners.

alex (oncall): closing thread — feel free to reopen if any customers escalate. :thumbsup: "
